challenges.name: Core Computing
rewardDetails:
Compute levels have diminishing returns based on an exponent that starts at 0.5.
Each completion of this challenge adds 0.04 to that exponent.
This results in an increasingly large difference as you gain more compute levels.

challenges.name: Synth Purity
descriptions: Synth Purity necessarily changes both synthesis XP and output. Alien recipes ignore these two normal-synthesis stats.

challenges.name: Power Hungry

effects.name: Void Power Boost Level Cost Divider

descriptions: Void Power Boost Drain Reduction: challenge contribution ×0.237305 (0.75^5).
Void Power Boost Level Cost Divider: challenge contribution ×1e+10 (100^5).

Drain uses base drain × (1 + drain-scaling stat)^(active level - 1) × running penalty; the reward scales that stat, not the entire drain directly. Engine Boost is excluded from the level-cost divider.
The six non-engine reactor boosts also receive the source's literal -0.1 cost-growth patch (1.5 → 1.4). This patch is assigned even at zero completions, not accumulated per completion.

challenges.name: Base Carry
descriptions: Base Building Cost Divider: challenge contribution ×3.125e+08 (50^5).
Only buildings with base_divider_effects use this cost divider; Fleet-base buildings use their separate base6 divider.

challengeBoosts.reconstruction: SaveLoad assigns saved fields, then the challenge button clamps completions and raises highest_target to the completed tier. Rewards and total challenges_completed are recalculated during loading; no cached PlayerInfo stats or total need editing.
